findings.desc: Backfill updated moderation receipts while their append-only trigger was active.
A newly allowlisted moderator could violate the actor users foreign key.
Legacy state buildings without buildingId disappeared from moderation.
Friend cards omitted legacy published buildings without persisted buildingId.
Cancel could reuse a stale identity-map row and overwrite a ready result.
Theme parameter-resolution errors escaped without terminalizing the durable job.
A result could mutate after a concurrent takedown committed while it waited for the social lock.
A force-sync flip could bypass replay of a previously accepted durable request.
Digest dedup could return a different request id without durable aliasing and later double-charge.
Attempt receipts copied an inert effort setting not sent to the physical model request.
Legacy completion checked takedown before acquiring its mutation lock.
Like and unlike checked takedown before acquiring their mutation lock.

verify.command: RUN_CONTROL_PLANE_POSTGRES_TESTS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_island_social_core_postgres.py tests/test_island_bots_postgres.py tests/test_island_theme_jobs_postgres.py tests/test_island_moderation_postgres.py
